tools.name: walmart_reviews
tools.description:
Walmart reviews for one product, with filters.

    product: Walmart item ID or product URL (e.g. "10450114").
    max_reviews: 1-200. stars: comma list like "1,2" for complaints.
    verified_only: verified purchases only. topic: Walmart review topic such as "Freshness".
    since: only reviews on/

tools.name: walmart_product
tools.description:
Walmart product details: price, stock, seller, category, rating breakdown and review topics.

    product: Walmart item ID or product URL.

tools.name: amazon_reviews
tools.description:
Amazon top reviews merged across marketplaces, plus Amazon's "Customers say" topics with sentiment.

    product: ASIN or Amazon product URL (e.g. "B00FLYWNYQ").
    marketplaces: comma list such as "US,CA,UK" (each adds its own ~8-13 top reviews; max 5).
